candidate_relations.reason: The patient has anti-centromere antibodies (94.8 AU/ml) and a negative anti-Scl-70, which are characteristic of systemic sclerosis, particularly the limited cutaneous form or sine scleroderma. There is no mention of anti-RNP antibodies, which are a hallmark of Mixed Connective Tissue Disease. Therefore, diagnosing MCTD conflicts with the serological profile and the more specific diagnosis of systemic sclerosis sine scleroderma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Mixed Connective Tissue Disease (MCTD) is a distinct entity from systemic sclerosis, although both are connective tissue diseases.
